name: thinloop
description: Simplify complex development with deep discovery, reliable delivery, and concise experiential knowledge.

interface.longDescription: Clarify consequential product decisions, keep implementation scoped and evidence-backed, and preserve proven development experience as concise project or personal knowledge without a fixed pipeline.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use SCD Discovery when product decisions are open, SCD Dev Loop for evidence-backed implementation, and SCD Knowledge only when I explicitly ask to capture or retrieve proven experience.
